arguments.command:
git stash && python3 -c "
import parse

# Test various timezone formats
tests = [
    ('a {:tt} b', 'a 10:21:36 AM +1000 b'),
    ('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+1000 b'),
]

for fmt, s in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    if r:
        dt = r[0]
        print(f'Format: {fmt}, String: {s}')
        print(f'  Result: {dt}')
        print(f'  Timezone: {dt.tzinfo}')
        if hasattr(dt.tzinfo, 'utcoffset'):
            print(f'  Offset: {dt.tzinfo.utcoffset(None)}')
" 2>&1 | tail -20
